subject: Enhance SCP/SFTP file browser with recursive operations and TreeView refresh
body:
Enhance SCP/SFTP file browser with recursive operations and TreeView refresh

- Add recursive directory upload/download support
  - UploadDirectoryAsync() and DownloadDirectoryAsync() methods
  - CreateRemoteDirectory() helper for remote directory creation
  - Progress callbacks show current file during recursive transfers
  - Maintains directory structure on both local and remote sides

- Fix recursive remote directory deletion
  - DeleteDirectory() now empties directories before deletion
  - Required because SFTP only deletes empty directories
  - Handles nested directory structures properly

- Add TreeView refresh after directory operations
  - RefreshTreeView() method for both local and remote panels
  - FindNodeByPath() helper to locate and refresh specific tree nodes
  - Preserves expanded state of other tree nodes
  - Auto-refreshes after upload, download, or delete of directories

- Update protocol display name to "SCP/SFTP (SSH.NET)"
  - Clarifies the protocol uses SSH.NET library
  - Distinguishes from other SCP implementations
